recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-10384; any additional review would belong to archived publication history rather than the current R6 source.
issue_request: FHIR-10384 was a Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics change request for the DSTU2 FHIR-core Sequence resource asking that Sequence.structureVariant cardinality be changed from 0..1 to 0..* so multiple structural variants could be represented when comparing a sequence to a reference.
initial_application: Commit a73007ec819a445301c6af23bafe1a76b6097308, "Fix [#10378], [#10379], [#10384]", changed source/sequence/sequence-spreadsheet.sheet.txt Row 47 for Sequence.structureVariant from "Card. = 0..1" to "Card. = 0..*".
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini does not list Sequence or MolecularSequence in active [resources], lists Sequence under [removed-resources], and comments out molecularsequence in current metadata. The current Diagnostics module says MolecularSequence has been replaced by MolecularDefinition. Later Published/Persuasive FHIR-36085 removed MolecularSequence.structureVariant for R5, and CG minutes record a 13-0-0 block vote accepting that removal. FHIR-50386 later recorded the Diagnostics-page transition from MolecularSequence toward MolecularDefinition.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the requested cardinality was already applied historically and current FHIR-core source has no active Sequence.structureVariant or MolecularSequence.structureVariant element whose cardinality should be changed.
